files.description: Strict record parser, total function and deliberate boolean mutant
Validated report import with atomic replacement and failure injection seam
Locked version store and allowlisted diagnostic event reference
Boundary, metamorphic, file-failure, race and local command-route tests
Commands, expected outputs, verification scope and safe local use
Three stage briefs, assessment rubrics and reference reasoning
Deliberate slice defect, cancellable resource and bounded benchmark
Regression, boundary, successful cleanup and cancelled cleanup checks
Tiny subject contrasting statement and branch execution
One-sided and both-direction branch test fixtures
Pdb commands, async event trace, optional branch report and timing experiment

tasks.title: Validated study-log parser
tasks.goal: Build a pure parser and independently demonstrate allowed values, type boundaries and malformed records.
steps: Read README.md and run the supplied references.
Attempt the stage brief before inspecting its reference solution.
Require exact id/minutes fields, nonblank bounded IDs and integer duration 0 through 1440.
Reject duplicate JSON keys, booleans, invalid JSON and oversized text.
Compute known totals and demonstrate a test distinguishing the supplied boolean mutant.
Produce a minimal reproduction note with expected and observed results.
Compare your evidence with the stage rubric and document extensions separately.

tasks.title: Failure-safe report importer
tasks.goal: Combine the parser with real temporary files and one deliberate replacement; preserve the old report on any rejected batch.
steps: Read README.md and run the supplied references.
Attempt the stage brief before inspecting its reference solution.
Validate at most 1000 rows and unique IDs before writing.
Serialize schema_version, records and total; read stored JSON back.
Use an injected replacement failure and assert old bytes remain.
Assert rejected input does not invoke replacement and temporary files are removed.
Compare your evidence with the stage rubric and document extensions separately.

tasks.title: Reproducible stale-writer diagnosis
tasks.goal: Prove the local version invariant under two competing stale edits and produce a bounded diagnostic report.
steps: Read README.md and run the supplied references.
Attempt the stage brief before inspecting its reference solution.
Use a Barrier so both threads read the same version before updating.
Allow exactly one compare-and-update commit; reject the stale proposal.
Join workers with bounds and assert final version and allowed winner.
Add seeded metamorphic totals and an allowlisted diagnostic event.
Write a release evidence table that separates thread/file tests from separately tested async cleanup and untested browser/distributed scopes.
Compare your evidence with the stage rubric and document extensions separately.

tasks.title: See a bug, cancellation and a missing branch
tasks.goal: Use debugger observations and runnable failure tests; measure a bounded optimization without confusing speed with correctness.
steps: Read diagnosis-workbook.md and predict each result before inspecting its solution.
Step through the deliberately wrong slice in pdb; record the missing element and caller.
Run successful and cancelled cleanup cases; explain the readiness event and absence of a commit.
Optionally measure the untested branch using coverage in a disposable environment.
Compare scan and index timing with setup included; record inputs, runtime and sample distributions.
